verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data publication (case or processing statistics, extracts) is a fair question for a government immigration service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only an interactive processing-times checker where you select an application type and get a backward-looking estimate. That is a per-query lookup tool, not a downloadable dataset or extract, and the pack contains no evidence of bulk downloads, open-data files, or statistical extracts.
